mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate directly increases the cost of capital for corporations, reducing their net present value of future cash flows and leading to lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sub-4.0% unemployment rate indicates a tight labor market that typically precedes central bank tightening to combat inflation, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based consumer recovery that boosts corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST growth fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-recession supply recovery phase, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals improving manufacturing activity and corporate capacity utilization, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods classified as post-recession supply recovery.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force participation and employment (PAYEMS) directly increases household income and consumption, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI inflation rate above 3.0% per annum (CPIAUCSL) indicates accelerating price pressures that typically prompt central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent acceleration in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad economic expansion that increases corporate earnings visibility, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 and RSAFS growth fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle (defined by a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS), the reduction in borrowing costs stimulates economic activity and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods classified as monetary easing cycles.
